title: Tool error not recovered: list_directory (src/moeb/internal/serve)
description: list_directory: cannot read e:\Code\Moeb\src/moeb/internal/serve — path does not exist. The MCP server implementation lives at src/moeb/src/mcp/, not src/moeb/internal/serve/. The error was benign (directory discovery for context only) and did not affect any file writes; recovery was via list_directory on the parent src/moeb directory.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why list_directory failed and whether the intended operation completed. If a file write was not applied, a write_file fallback or retry is required before the next run succeeds.
